title: Adolescent Love
description: For nine years, I have always been in first place throughout the entire school. I thought that once I entered high school, everything would stay the same. But, someone had actually taken my spot in first place! Unwilling to give up my spot, I switched up my appearance to make my rival fall into my love trap! Amazuppai Junjou,初戀的酸甜滋味,甘酸っぱい純情
